segments.name: Human capital management
segments.description: Provides cloud-based human capital management, finance and IT software to U.S. businesses, unifying payroll, HR, finance and IT workflows.
segments.evidence: The Company has thus determined that it operates in a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay recurring per-employee fees for the software solutions they purchase, plus implementation services and other fees.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive revenue from a client based on the solutions purchased by the client, the number of client employees and the amount, type and timing of services provided with respect to those client employees.
